name: CYGNO
full_name: A CYGNus TPC with Optical readout
summary: CYGNO is an Italian gas-TPC project with optical readout within the international CYGNUS directional-detection programme. It uses He/CF4 gas to study light WIMPs and directional neutrino signals.
detection_principle: Ionization electrons drift to GEMs, where they are amplified and generate light. High-resolution sCMOS images provide two-dimensional tracks; PMT timing adds the third coordinate.
